hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: In this extended dial system, the wheel length is m instead of ten.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Compute the minimal circular distance between current position and target position using modulo m arithmetic.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sum the minimal distances across all consecutive destination steps.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def minRotationsToDialModM(target: list[int], m: int) -> int:
    curr = 0
    total = 0
    for dig in target:
        diff = abs(curr - dig)
        total += min(diff, m - diff)
        curr = dig
    return total
```
